prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one portrait background for chapter 4 of Elements - Icons.
Reference image: style, palette, geography and generous play-space reference.
Earnest rustic hand-coloured woodcut on warm ochre paper: slate blue water, muted olive vegetation, clay red accents, warm black irregular cuts. Broad simpler lines, occasional knife slips, dry missed ink and imperfect colour registration. Beautiful old printed landscape, not cute, not a game illustration. Portrait 390:844 composition. No writing, borders, UI, loose inventory objects or people.
The player begins on the NEAR bank. The orchard, cooking clearing, lean-to and later cottage all stand on that SAME near bank, connected by a dry path. Crossing the brook later leads away from home toward the mill and village. Never put home or orchard on the far bank. Where water is visible it flows from RIGHT to LEFT; never mirror a reference. Forked willow on the left, twin poplars across the water, two low hills toward the right horizon.
SCENE: Approaching the unbridged brook from our home bank. The cottage we just built stands upper RIGHT on our NEAR bank: cream plaster, rough dark timber, ochre thatch, square window on left and doorway on right. Orchard beside it on same bank. Water crosses upper third from right to left. A path on the opposite bank leads to a distant red-roof mill barn. No bridge yet; broad open earth on our bank.
Generous natural play space: the middle 70% of the width from 38% to 90% of the image height is a continuous empty pale ochre clearing or worn floor, with faint sparse print grain only. Keep scenery in the top third and outer margins. No clutter, strong shadows or dense hatching through this open working space. Do not draw a rectangular blank panel.
Keep all landscape spatially coherent and continuous with the reference.
